brief_rationale: The doctor systematically obtained specific home BP readings, screened all relevant red-flag symptoms, confirmed antihypertensive execution without self-directed dose changes, maintained the ophthalmic postoperative regimen, converted transport/cost barriers into executable tiered plans, and closed with family teach-back confirmation. Every responsibility-chain item (RC1–RC7) was met without error, and four high-order points (HO1–HO4) were actively completed with distinct, beyond-minimum actions, making this a strict perfect trajectory.
